name: leshy-qwen-s31
prompt: A monochrome silverpoint character study: a single figure alone on plain off-white paper, drawn only in fine grey metalpoint lines and hatching. An uncanny old spirit of the forest in the shape of a gaunt, wild old man, dressed in moss, bark, dead leaves and forest debris. One of his arms is gnarled and knotted like a tree branch, half arm and half wood. From his head grow branching antlers of gnarled tree branches, many-pointed like a stag's antlers but made of wood and twigs. He has a long, tangled beard, a long drooping moustache and dishevelled hair hanging down. His eyes are wild, staring and cold, and his expression is unfriendly and menacing: a wandering creature of the woods that might eat a lost traveller. His legs are reverse-jointed, bending backward at the knee like the hind legs of a beast, and end in gnarled, clawed feet. Full-length figure: the whole body from head to feet inside the frame, isolated on blank paper. silverpoint study, metalpoint drawing, bestiary illustration, hatching and cross-hatching, fine line, high contrast, sharp focus, monochrome, clean light paper ground
